about: Supporting log of the products file: field sources, missing-value reasons, store and fulfillment checks against the site's own data, offer details, the store-assortment decision apart from the current offer, the UPC outcome of each product's own page, and the collection segment that observed each product. 'observation_kind' is 'fresh' (observed by this run; 'observation.earlier_segment' is true when an earlier segment of this resumed run observed it) or 'carried_forward' (not observed by this run: an earlier run's verified observation kept unchanged, with its own crawl date, in 'historical').
